questions.question_text: Perform two-way ANOVA on the given agricultural table across treatments A, B, C, D and determine whether land blocks differ significantly.
Perform Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) on Class 1 = {(2,3), (3,2), (3,4), (2,2)} and Class 2 = {(7,8), (8,7), (8,9), (7,7)} and classify query point (4,5).
Calculate the third quartile and compute the probability that sample mean is between 110 to 120 hours for video projector bulbs with mean 100 hours and SD 75.
Compute the 95% and 99% confidence limits of the cytokine response of mice given observation vector [0.2, 1.3, 1.4, 2.3, 4.2, 4.7, 4.7, 5.1].
Construct a 95% confidence interval for the population variance given sample variance 36 hours squared from 25 tested LED bulbs.
Calculate Spearman's Rank Correlation Coefficient with tie corrections for Math and Physics scores across the 6 students dataset.
Determine the mean values, correlation coefficient, and standard deviation of Y given regression equations 7x - 5y + 14 = 0 and 28x - 25y - 35 = 0.
Explain the significance of ROC curve. Determine which model exhibits superior performance based on comparative AUC curves.
Explain the concept of Inductive learning and describe any two types of Bias with real-world examples.
Construct the confusion matrix, calculate False Positive and False Negative metrics for the 200 email classification dataset.
Differentiate between Post Pruning and Pre-pruning methods of Decision Tree. Formulate how overfitting is detected.
Derive the optimization function for linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) and formulate the discriminant function.
Apply K-means algorithm on given 2D coordinates A(2,2), B(3,2), C(1,1), D(3,1), E(1.5,0.5) to partition into two clusters for two iterations.
Describe the architecture and voting mechanism of bagging in ensemble methods. Analyze the reduction in model variance.
Differentiate between Single Link, Complete Link, and Average Link agglomerative hierarchical clustering.
Evaluate the clinical dataset with attributes [Cholesterol, Diabetic, Family History, Blood Pressure] and predict the risk label for test query point.
